WITH map_items AS (
  SELECT itemid
  FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_icu.d_items`
  WHERE LOWER(label) LIKE '%mean arterial%'
     OR LOWER(label) LIKE '%mean arterial pressure%'
     OR LOWER(label) LIKE '%map%'
     OR LOWER(abbreviation) LIKE '%map%'
),
map_events AS (
  SELECT
    ce.subject_id,
    ce.hadm_id,
    ce.valuenum
  FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_icu.chartevents` ce
  JOIN map_items di
    ON ce.itemid = di.itemid
  WHERE ce.valuenum IS NOT NULL
    AND ce.valuenum > 0
),
max_map_per_adm AS (
  -- maximum MAP per hospital admission
  SELECT
    hadm_id,
    subject_id,
    MAX(valuenum) AS max_map
  FROM map_events
  GROUP BY hadm_id, subject_id
),
cohort_admissions AS (
  -- female patients aged 82-92 inclusive
  SELECT a.hadm_id
  FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
  JOIN `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
    ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
  WHERE p.gender = 'F'
    AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 82 AND 92
)
SELECT
  APPROX_QUANTILES(m.max_map, 2)[OFFSET(1)] AS median_of_admission_max_map_mmHg,
  COUNT(*) AS admissions_count
FROM max_map_per_adm m
JOIN cohort_admissions c
  ON m.hadm_id = c.hadm_id;
